title: Supper for the Sightless: Gorveth, the Starved Listener
summary: Ring an available dinner bell, leave its lane and bait the blind hunter through the ghostly oven flame.
overview: Gorveth follows sound through three fixed dinner-bell lanes. Most attacks against his Starved Hide are weakened; a correctly baited charge opens a short damage window.
Choose the bell together, then move clear. The used bell rests for one cycle, so rotate between the remaining lanes.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Read the announced lane and leave it before the charge resolves.
Use the available bells, not an equipment item from the loot table.

roles.label: Bell caller
tips: Ring an available bell during the six-second listening window.
Choose a lane that carries Gorveth through its furnace flame.
Allow the additional six-second charge warning before moving back in.

roles.label: Damage and control
tips: Use damage cooldowns after a successful charge strips the hide.
Control hunger shades from missed charges.

roles.label: Tank
tips: Expect Gorveth to stop ordinary melee while preparing his charge.
Reestablish the fight after his brief stun without standing in the lane.

phases.label: The starving hunter
phases.description: Starved Hide reduces incoming damage to 60% of normal. Fight while preparing the next bell choice.

phases.label: He is listening
phases.description: Gorveth pauses for six seconds while a player rings an available bell. The chosen lane then receives a further six-second warning.

phases.label: Flame through the hide
phases.trigger: A charge crosses the correct flame
phases.description: The successful charge stuns Gorveth for two seconds and removes Starved Hide for 15 seconds.

abilities.name: Starved Hide
abilities.summary: A successful bait opens the full-damage window.
description: Gorveth otherwise takes 60% of normal damage. Continue fighting, but plan stronger attacks for the 15-second exposure.

abilities.name: Dinner Bell
abilities.summary: Ring one available bell and clear its marked lane.
description: The used bell is unavailable for one cycle. Failing to ring an available bell leaves the hide intact and creates a hunger shade.
Standing in the charge lane causes 350 physical damage and a short displacement to a safe point. Cold resistance does not answer a physical charge.

sections.title: Expedition access and route
paragraphs: The Seven Silences admits groups of three to six characters of level 55 or higher; six level-60 characters are recommended. Speak to Keeper Avel Rimeglass in Iceclad. Entry requires no raid trophy.
The eight-hour expedition and replay begin at acceptance. The lower floors start below the difficulty of the Mistmoore group expedition, then increase toward comparable pressure on the upper floors.

Ordinary tower keys, keyring entries and the summit shortcut do not unlock this version. Each floor victory unlocks the next expedition mirror and a cleared return checkpoint. The two wings of floor six form one encounter.

sections.title: Warnings and recovery
paragraphs: Read Event Messages and use the named encounter actors. Color and visual effects supplement the instructions; no required answer depends on recognizing a color alone. Keep the fight and its support inside the current encounter area.

Evacuation returns eligible party members to the entrance of this same expedition. Gate and spells that transport you out of the tower remain available; reenter through the keeper while your expedition and membership remain valid. Binding, shadow steps, summons and transport within the tower cannot bypass its mirrors.

A wipe restores the active boss and its attempt-only objectives. Previously completed encounters and route objectives remain completed. Cleared bosses cannot be repeated for another reward during the same expedition.
The expedition supplies the temporary tools needed for each mechanic. No random equipment reward or particular class is required to perform an interaction.

loot.title: Equipment reward
loot.description: Exactly one item is chosen from these four, with a 25% chance for each item. Supporting creatures and encounter objectives do not award additional equipment.

loot.title: Independent raid-entry reward
loot.description: There is a separate 30% chance for one entry splinter per boss victory. This roll does not replace the equipment reward and is not repeated for each player. The splinter is permanent, stackable, No Trade and not Lore.
